historical_reconstructed.quote_clock: explicit reconstructed_quote_at; never earlier than observation date
historical_reconstructed.derived_ytd_clock: maximum parent research_available_at; no fabricated official release timestamp
historical_reconstructed.derived_ytd_definition: sum of earliest accepted monthly publications in the same calendar year, unit, currency and statistical scope; may differ from revised official cumulative series

retention: standardized data and compact source/formula metadata only; no new raw snapshots or before/after copies

market_repairs.pb_policy: PB kept null when latest disclosed historical reconstructed BPS<=0 and fiscal age<=150d; not a claim that negative PB cannot be calculated mathematically.
